headword: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}

definitions.gloss: change of seasons; seasonal transition; turning point between seasons
definitions.explanation: The transitional period when one season shifts to the next. In Japan, these transitions are culturally significant and are closely associated with changes in health, wardrobe, and diet.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}し→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧やすい。
examples.english: It's easy to get sick at the change of seasons.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{衣替|ころもが}え→衣替え：07709_koromogae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: People switch out their wardrobes at the change of seasons.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変動|へんどう}→変動：09936_hendou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かない→引く：01978_hiku⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Temperature fluctuations are large during the change of seasons, so please be careful not to catch a cold.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧ (season) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + ⟦{変|か}わり{目|め}→変わり目：12118_kawarime⟧ (turning point, transition). A very common expression in daily life, especially in health-related conversations. Japanese culture places great importance on seasonal transitions, and this phrase appears frequently in weather forecasts, health advice, and everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}す→体調を崩す：16480_taichouwokuzusu⟧: to fall ill at the change of seasons
- {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: seasonal transition greetings
- {季節|きせつ}の{変|か}わり{目|め}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: caution is needed at seasonal transitions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{移|うつ}り{変|か}わり→移り変わり：13760_utsurikawari⟧: seasonal change — similar meaning, slightly more literary
- ⟦{端境期|はざかいき}→端境期：10041_hazakaiki⟧: between-seasons period — originally an agricultural term for the gap between harvests
